plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-DIR1): Directory: connector clients
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Six small items across contracts, the connect Worker and the anywhere-channel web client; 13 files total.

narratives.Problem: The overdeck.ai directory accepts only phones (ios/android) as clients, capped at 5 per account. The connector that W-CONN2 builds (pan mcp connector, platform node) needs to join as a client without taking a machine slot or a phone slot. The epic PRD's W-DIR1 also missed three things: loadDirectory drops non-phone rows on rehydration, PushRegistration would become type-legal for node, and DirectoryWebClient overwrites the limit message with the phone wording on close 4013.
narratives.Proposal: Split the contracts type into PhonePlatform (ios|android, used for push) and ClientPlatform = PhonePlatform | node. Add CONNECTOR_LIMIT = 10 and CONNECTOR_LIMIT_MESSAGE. The decoder accepts hello-client with node and still refuses node push-register. The reducer counts phones and connectors against separate caps and recounts on a family change. loadDirectory reloads node rows. DirectoryWebClient takes ClientPlatform and picks the limit message by platform. CONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 1. Docs describe the connector limit and the deploy-before-connector order.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Deploying connect.overdeck.ai: operator-only (docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md Deploy, PAN-4927 CP-5); no agent runs wrangler
- The connector process, credential or pairing (W-CONN1, W-CONN2) and the Bots settings UI (W-BOT1)
- Changing CONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION from 1
- Any new close code, error code, frame type or SQLite column
- Changing apps/mobile types or behavior (it keeps ClientPlatform)
- Connector-specific wording for forget-client or the forgotten refusal
- A new miniflare/workerd integration test for connectors
- Changing any phone message, the 5-phone cap or the 3-machine free cap

autoDecisions.summary: Split PhonePlatform (ios|android) from ClientPlatform (PhonePlatform|node); push-register and PushRegistration use PhonePlatform.
autoDecisions.rationale: Widening ClientPlatform alone makes a node push registration type-legal and routes it to FCM in push/deliver.ts; the split makes the epic's 'push-register from node is bad_frame' rule hold at compile time too.

autoDecisions.summary: A re-hello that moves a client row to the other family counts against the new family's cap and clears its push registration.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without it a phone row flipped to node bypasses the connector cap and keeps a phone push token; recounting is three lines and needs no new error path.
The current filter drops node rows on every Durable Object rehydration, so connectors would vanish and the cap would reset; the epic PRD missed it.

autoDecisions.summary: DirectoryWebClient picks the 4013 message by deps.platform instead of the REFUSALS map entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: The close handler overwrites the error frame's message with CLIENT_LIMIT_MESSAGE; choosing by platform is deterministic and covers a close with no error frame.

autoDecisions.summary: apps/mobile stays on ClientPlatform; no mobile edits.
autoDecisions.rationale: PhonePlatform is a subset, so mobile compiles unchanged; moving shellPlatform belongs with mobile push work.

autoDecisions.summary: The CP-5 directory deploy is not a plan item; the PR description must state the operator redeploy requirement.
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md says no agent deploys; making the requirement visible in the PR lets the Flywheel hold W-CONN2.
